tickets.title: Review benefits enrollment options
tickets.text:
Use this checklist during benefits enrollment review:
- Confirm enrollment window and whether changes are new, annual, or life-event related.
- Compare medical plan premiums, deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums, network access, and prescription coverage.
- Review HSA or FSA eligibility, contribution limits, employer funding, and carryover rules.
- Check dental and vision coverage against expected needs.
- Review group life, disability, accident, critical illness, and supplemental insurance options.
- Confirm beneficiary designations for employer benefits and retirement plans.
- Note payroll deduction impact and any coordination needed with cash flow or tax planning.
- Identify follow-up documents or elections Rina Copperwisp must complete through the benefits portal.
Review Rina Copperwisp's new employer benefits through Amber Teapot Pediatrics' online enrollment portal, covering medical, dental, vision, HSA, disability, and group life choices, before the enrollment window closes.
tickets.evidence: Because the portal presents medical, dental, vision, HSA, disability, and group life choices and the household wants the selections reviewed before the enrollment window closes, the agreed follow-up is to review the choices, dated 2023-11-24.

tickets.title: Collect mortgage document packet
tickets.text: Use this workflow to gather a complete mortgage document packet before analysis or submission. Confirm the requested purpose, collect current loan and property documents, identify missing items, and prepare a clean packet for advisor review. Do not include real account numbers in the task notes; store sensitive documents only in the approved client file location. Gather current mortgage, escrow, property tax, homeowners insurance, and asset documentation for Elias and Rina Copperwisp's Asheville purchase file at Mossy Meteor Lending before the lender's next underwriting review.

subTasks.title: Confirm mortgage request scope
subTasks.text: Clarify whether the packet is for a new purchase, refinance, home equity review, payoff planning, or lender documentation request. Note required document categories and any relative timing expectations.

subTasks.title: Gather property and loan documents
subTasks.text: Request or locate the current mortgage statement, escrow statement if applicable, property tax bill, homeowners insurance declarations page, purchase or refinance closing disclosure if available, and any lender checklist provided by the client.

subTasks.title: Check packet for gaps
subTasks.text: Compare received documents against the requested checklist. Flag missing pages, outdated statements, mismatched property addresses, or unclear ownership information for follow-up.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor review summary
subTasks.text: Summarize loan type, rate structure, payment components, remaining term, escrow status, and open questions. Link the organized document packet in the secure file location.

tickets.evidence: Mossy Meteor Lending requested current mortgage, escrow, property tax, homeowners insurance, and asset documentation for the Asheville purchase file, and the agreed follow-up is to organize the packet before the lender’s next underwriting review, dated 2023-11-27.

tickets.title: Escalate Teacup Comet Bank transfer limitation
tickets.text: Escalate the temporary online transfer limitation at Teacup Comet Bank for Elias and Rina Copperwisp so verified closing funds can move without relying on mailed checks, after the household used a forwarding address.
tickets.evidence: Teacup Comet Bank placed a temporary online transfer limitation after the household used a forwarding address, and Elias wants the issue escalated so verified closing funds can move without relying on mailed checks; the agreed follow-up is dated 2023-12-01.

tickets.title: Review financial plan assumptions and recommendations
tickets.text: Review Elias and Rina Copperwisp's financial plan for current assumptions, retirement income needs, tax-aware investment considerations, rollover opportunities, cash flow changes, insurance gaps, estate planning coordination items, and next-step recommendations. Document evidence reviewed and summarize planning updates for the Copperwisps' conversation. Update the plan assumptions for the new Asheville home purchase and relocation cash flow, replacing the Portland mortgage payment, Oregon tax assumptions, and prior cash reserve target.
tickets.evidence: The advisor review found that the existing plan still uses the Portland mortgage payment, Oregon tax assumptions, and prior cash reserve target, so the agreed follow-up is to update the plan assumptions for the new home purchase and relocation cash flow, dated 2023-12-18.

tickets.title: Review insurance policy coverage
tickets.text: Review the Copperwisps' Oregon-based homeowners, auto, and umbrella policy structure with Silver Marmot Insurance against the new Asheville property and household risk profile, since the move changes the insured residence, auto garaging location, and umbrella-policy underwriting details.
tickets.evidence: Because the move changes the insured residence, auto garaging location, and umbrella-policy underwriting details, the agreed follow-up is to review the Oregon-based policy structure against the new property and household risk profile, dated 2023-12-08.

tickets.title: Clarify payroll address mismatch with Cloudberry Kite Analytics
tickets.text: Clarify the unresolved mismatch between the Oregon resident address and the North Carolina remote-work location in Elias Copperwisp's Cloudberry Kite Analytics employer portal with payroll and the household's tax preparer.
tickets.evidence: Elias’s employer portal shows an Oregon resident address while the remote-work location field reflects North Carolina, creating an unresolved mismatch that needs clarification with payroll and the household’s tax preparer, dated 2023-12-06.

tickets.title: Coordinate household mailing address change
tickets.text: Coordinate the Copperwisps' mailing address change across advisory records, custodian profiles, tax form delivery settings, and routine service-provider records once the Asheville residence is usable for mail.
tickets.evidence: Elias asked Pocket Lantern Advisory to coordinate the household mailing address change across advisory records, custodian profiles, tax form delivery settings, and routine service-provider records once the Asheville residence is usable for mail; that agreed follow-up is dated 2024-01-15.
